Leah: Quick final check for next week's webinar. Need a one-line ack: keynote length, demo owner, who flips the failover toggle, and rehearsal windows. Keep it tight.

Ava: I'll own slides + two-size benchmark card (deck + promo). Need Priya's numbers by EOD Wed.

Priya: Will deliver benchmark CSV, a 50-token demo prompt, and expected outputs by tomorrow. I recommend 15/25/20 split to give the demo room to breathe.

Ravi: I'll own demo reliability & failover. Plan: Primary = Dedicated pool, fallback = Hosted quantized variant, final fallback = EU warm-cache. I'll add a greenroom toggle and a 1-line scrub that zeroes secrets before we start.

Ethan: I'll moderate, run a 2-min poll after the keynote (PoC / Scaling / Security) and own SDR routing rules. After demo CTA, "request demo" maps by ARR band: >100k -> SDR A; else -> SDR B.

Ops: Confirmed Zoom->SFDC mapping to campaign "webinar-slate-surge". We'll tag interest_level, demo_click, and arr_band. Queues and mapping will be set by Tue EOD. Recording retention default 90 days.

Oliver: Joining the panel; can upload slides Wed noon and will sign recording consent.

Leah: Draft run-of-show (60m):
```
0:00 - 0:02  Housekeeping + tech tips (Leah)
0:02 - 0:17  Keynote: cost-aware inference (Sarah)
0:17 - 0:42  Live demo: Dedicated vs Hosted (Miguel + Ravi)
0:42 - 0:56  Panel: tradeoffs & real-world patterns (Oliver, Sarah, Miguel)
0:56 - 1:00  CTA + lead routing recap (Leah + Ethan)
```
Rehearsals: tech check 30m (48h prior), full dress 60m (24h prior), final mic 15m (15m prior). Greenroom will include Ops + Ravi to run toggles.

Ava: Deliverables: infographic (long + compact) Mon EOD; I'll also include a "how-to-reproduce" slide.

Priya: Will post the demo prompt + reproducibility CLI in #marketing-assets when ready.

Ravi: Will push the toggle + scrub to /rehearsals/demo-fallbacks and ping when ready.

Ethan: Will draft the poll + post-webinar nurture cadence (infographic + 3-step demo CTA).

Ops: Will create SFDC queues and validate mapping by Tue. We'll log demo clicks as activities.

Leah: Outstanding actions (short):
- Ava: infographic + chase Oliver slides (Mon EOD)
- Priya: demo prompt + numbers (tomorrow)
- Ravi: failover toggle + scrub (Wed)
- Ethan: poll + nurture copy (Tue)
- Ops: SFDC queues & mapping (Tue)
- All speakers: sign consent + upload slides (Wed noon)
